altJa: 濃い紫色の細長い卵形の果実に、緑色のへたと短い柄が付いたナスのイラスト。果実全体を斜めに描いています。
observationJa: ふくらみのある細長い輪郭、表面のつや、へたと柄が付く位置を見比べます。ここでは一つの果実の外観を観察します。
limitJa: ナスの外観を学ぶための一例です。形や色、へたの様子は品種や状態によって異なり、この図だけで全てのナスを識別したり、品種・品質・熟度・病害を判定したりはしません。

provenance.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: original adult agriculture-learning crop recognition illustration. Draw ONE whole eggplant fruit, a common moderately elongated oval shape, smooth glossy deep purple skin, natural green leafy calyx snugly attached at the narrow upper end with a short gently curved green stem. The eggplant should be plump elongated oval, not a very long thin cucumber shape, not a round tomato. Entire outline, calyx and stem fully visible with generous breathing room. Place it slightly diagonally across a square warm ivory background. Gentle botanical 2D painted illustration with clean contour, restrained soft shading and one subtle glossy highlight, matching an approachable educational vegetable atlas rather than a photograph or 3D product render. No extra eggplants, no leaves/plant attached beyond the calyx, no cut fruit, no roots, no soil, no ruler or scale, no labels, no writing, no letters, no watermark. Depict one generic common-appearance example, not a named cultivar or a diagnostic comparison. Use an independently designed composition. No reference images.
